subject: importinto: disable some feature for nextgen when sem enabled (#61370)
summary: Diff adds executor-side guards in `Plan.initOptions` for NextGen+SEM to reject `IMPORT INTO ... FROM SELECT ...`, reject local-sort (requires non-empty `tidb_cloud_storage_uri`), and reject per-statement `disk_quota`/`max_write_speed`/`cloud_storage_uri`; adds coverage in `pkg/executor/import_into_test.go`. No remaining Blocker/High issues found relative to first parent; later upstream has additional related changes but no evidence of a fix needed for this commit.
